title: Centenarium Aqua Frigida
description: Centenarium Aqua Frigida in Mauretania Sitifensis (Algeria) is known only from a Latin inscription. Munzi et al. report that the inscription's findspot in the vicinity of Tizi Kafrida/K’frida is associated with extant Roman remains and that the modern toponym (Tala K’frida) may be a corruption of Frigida.
